sloka: अनङ्ग इति विख्यातः तदा प्रभृति राघव ।स च अङ्ग विषयः श्रीमान् यत्र अंगम् स मुमोच ह ॥१-२३-१४॥
transliteration: anaṅga iti vikhyātaḥ tadā prabhṛti rāghava ।sa ca aṅga viṣayaḥ śrīmān yatra aṁgam sa mumoca ha ॥1-23-14॥

translations.english: O descendant of the Raghus, from that time onwards, he was known as 'Ananga' (one without form). The beautiful place where he gave up his body is known as Angadesa.
